entries.title: Fixed Spiral Curtain and Open Header Roll Shutter
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed half-raised roll-shutter doorway with an intentionally open-front header. One uninterrupted finite-thickness curtain runs from its full lower bar up through two straight inward-open C-section jamb guides and continues into a true one-and-a-half-turn separated spiral around the entire upper barrel. The straight curtain has shallow geometric corrugations and the roll has real layer gaps, not a cylinder placed above an unrelated flat panel. A complete upper shaft and both full bearing sleeves sit in two entire side cheeks, joined by a back plate and proud roof cap; the header front is deliberately absent to expose the winding geometry. A full threshold and two lower captive shoe appearances complete the same one doorway. All material surfaces and profiles newly authored, no old door/screen mesh imported. Unlike the complete sectional door with ten independent panels, side rollers and tracks turning into long horizontal overhead returns, this has a continuous coiled curtain retained by straight jamb channels and a compact winding head. Unlike the tripod projection screen, no mast, tripod or upward blank display sheet is used. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum. One static architectural equipment prop zero scenes. No host building, people, powered or manual operation, curtain bending or rolling, continuous passage, locks, security, weather sealing, fire resistance, egress, installation, mechanical fit, load or safety capability verified. Rigging animation interaction not made.
